Ava (partnerships): Heads up — GCP Marketplace is rejecting PO 00-4772 for AcmeCorp during onboarding. Error is a validation failure on the PO XML -> `billingEntity` + `tax_id` combo. Customer hit onboarding hold.
Liam (procurement): Ugh, that PO is from our deal desk. Can you paste the raw payload and the exact error?
Ava (partnerships): Pasting trimmed request + error from their portal:```xml
<purchaseOrder>
  <poNumber>00-4772</poNumber>
  <vendorAlias>redwood-inference</vendorAlias>
  <billingEntity>REDWOOD-US</billingEntity>
  <taxId>12-3456789</taxId> <!-- EIN formatted w/ hyphen -->
</purchaseOrder>
```
MarketplaceBot: ERROR 422: InvalidTaxIdFormat — marketplace expects numeric-only tax_id for vendor alias mapping; hyphens rejected. Refer to https://gcp.marketplace/docs/po-schema
Ethan (sales): Customer is stuck because their internal finance system requires EIN with hyphen. They can't change formatting without sync from their ERP. This is blocking the contract signature + activation.
Maya (legal): Are there any redlines here? Does the PO need edit or can we accept an alternate doc (e.g., invoice with formatted EIN) to satisfy GCP? Also need to confirm signatory details match PO.
Liam (procurement): Two options: 1) we normalize tax id on our side before sending to Marketplace (strip non-digits) and store original in our records, or 2) request AcmeCorp to submit without hyphen. Option 1 seems better for UX but we need approval from Legal and Product.
Ava (partnerships): I can ask AcmeCorp but they're unlikely to change ERP. Can we do option 1 as a temporary workaround? This is a recurring pattern for EU VAT numbers too.
Maya (legal): Temporary data transformation is ok if we persist original unaltered for audit and show both forms on contract docs. Need Engineering + Security to sign off on transform policy. I'll draft a short amendment clause: "Normalization of tax identifier formatting for marketplace submission does not alter legal identity of the payer."
Liam (procurement): Also flag: GCP's vendor alias mapping fails if billingEntity != registered entity in their system. For safety, we should add a validation step that cross-checks the billingEntity->vendorId mapping before sending. If mismatch, route to manual review queue.
Ethan (sales): Customer impacted (AcmeCorp) is onboarding this week — can we do a manual submission to GCP in the meantime? Who owns manual escalations?
Ava (partnerships): I'll open a ticket with GCP partner support now and request manual PO acceptance for 00-4772 while we implement normalization. Ticket: https://partner-support.gcp/INC-9812 (internal ref).
MarketplaceBot: Partner ticket INC-9812 created by Ava. Status: open. ETA from GCP support currently 48-72h.
Liam (procurement): I'll schedule a quick two-hour engineering spike to add a normalization flag and a validation check. ETA end of day tomorrow. Assigning to eng-infra.
Maya (legal): I'll circulate the amendment language to @Ava and @Liam for signature. Need to include retention of original tax id in our records and a note about audit trail.
Ethan (sales): Thanks — please keep AcmeCorp updated. If GCP can do manual acceptance, that buys us time.
Ava (partnerships): Will do. I'll post updates here once GCP replies or when the spike lands. :thumbsup:
Liam (procurement): Adding one more note — update internal onboarding checklist: "Marketplace PO tax_id normalization = on by default for GCP/AWS marketplaces" so ops don't forget.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder scheduled: follow up INC-9812 in 48h.
